components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The next safe action in a review or settings workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius, 0.375rem); background: var(--primary, hsl(169 32% 28%)); color: var(--primary-foreground, hsl(96 25% 97%)); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: filter 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.86); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, hsl(169 32% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary decision or conventional administrative action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--input, hsl(135 10% 76%)); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.375rem); background: var(--background, hsl(105 14% 96%)); color: var(--foreground, hsl(162 17% 11%)); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent, hsl(150 18% 88%)); color: var(--accent-foreground, hsl(169 32% 22%)); } .ds-btn-outline:active { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, hsl(169 32% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The standard 44px field used in review, maintenance, and settings forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; color: var(--foreground, hsl(162 17% 11%)); font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--input, hsl(135 10% 76%)); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.375rem); background: var(--background, hsl(105 14% 96%)); color: var(--foreground, hsl(162 17% 11%)); font: 400 0.875rem/1.25 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 hsl(162 17% 11% / 0.05); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, hsl(156 7% 36%)); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ring, hsl(169 32% 32%)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, hsl(169 32% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

Review

components.css: .ds-nav { width: 16rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; color: var(--sidebar-foreground, hsl(162 17% 17%)); font-family: 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-label { padding: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.68rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-item { height: 2.5rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius, 0.375rem); color: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--sidebar-accent, hsl(145 15% 85%)); color: var(--sidebar-accent-foreground, hsl(169 32% 20%)); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page'] { font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sidebar-ring, hsl(169 32% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Queued Status Badge
components.description: A semantic status pill that pairs a clock icon, text, and archival-green color.
components.html: Queued
components.css: .ds-status-pending { min-height: 1.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, hsl(169 32% 28%)) 20%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, hsl(169 32% 28%)) 10%, transparent); color: var(--primary, hsl(169 32% 28%)); font: 500 0.75rem/1rem 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-status-pending svg { width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Register Panel
components.description: The square-edged document and operations sleeve defined by a rule and restrained shadow.
components.css: .ds-register-panel { padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border, hsl(135 10% 82%)) 90%, transparent); border-radius: 0; background: var(--card, hsl(90 20% 99%)); color: var(--card-foreground, hsl(162 17% 11%)); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -26px hsl(162 17% 11% / 0.45); font-family: 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-register-panel h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 600; } .ds-register-panel p { margin: 0.125rem 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, hsl(156 7% 36%)); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5rem; } .ds-register-panel:hover { border-color: var(--border, hsl(135 10% 82%)); } .ds-register-panel:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, hsl(169 32% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Register Disclosure
components.description: Progressive disclosure for evidence, filters, maintenance, recovery, and danger.
components.html:
Decision evidence
Classification and judge reasoning remain available without competing with the decision.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border, hsl(135 10% 82%)) 90%, transparent); background: var(--card, hsl(90 20% 99%)); color: var(--card-foreground, hsl(162 17% 11%)); font-family: 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure summary { min-height: 2.75rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-disclosure summary::after { content: '+'; color: var(--muted-foreground, hsl(156 7% 36%)); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-disclosure[open] summary::after { content: '−'; } .ds-disclosure summary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted, hsl(110 11% 92%)) 40%, transparent); } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, hsl(169 32% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-disclosure-body { padding: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, hsl(135 10% 82%)); color: var(--muted-foreground, hsl(156 7% 36%)); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5rem; }

components.name: Changed Register Row
components.description: The signature proposed-value row that keeps changed and prior document metadata together.
components.css: .ds-change-list { margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border, hsl(135 10% 82%)); background: var(--card, hsl(90 20% 99%)); color: var(--card-foreground, hsl(162 17% 11%)); font-family: 'Public Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-change-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, hsl(169 32% 28%)) 4.5%, transparent); } .ds-change-row dt { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-change-row dd { min-width: 0; margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-change-row strong { display: block; font-weight: 500; } .ds-change-row del { display: block; margin-top: 0.25rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, hsl(156 7% 36%)); font-size: 0.75rem; text-decoration-color: var(--border, hsl(135 10% 82%)); } .ds-change-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, hsl(169 32% 28%)) 7%, transparent); } .ds-change-list:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, hsl(169 32% 32%)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; } @media (max-width: 639px) { .ds-change-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; } }

narrative.overview:
ArchiBot feels like a municipal transfer register refined into a modern personal admin tool: mineral stock, archival green dividers, oxide decision marks, and crisp ledger rules organize one document at a time. The interface is calm, factual, and document-centric rather than dashboard-like or decorative.

Routine review is deliberately fast and open. The current document, proposed changes, and next safe action dominate; technical evidence, advanced filters, maintenance, and danger controls remain available through progressive disclosure. New entity approvals deserve additional visual pause and explicit consequence language because they cross a higher-risk boundary.

Public Sans gives the register a polished conventional admin voice. Light and dark themes preserve the same semantic roles, compact geometry, and rule-led hierarchy rather than becoming separate visual identities.
keyCharacteristics: Mineral-stock surfaces and archival-green structure with oxide reserved for destructive decisions.
Crisp ledger dividers, restrained structural shadows, and a compact 0.375rem corner language.
One dominant document workspace with routine decisions kept close and secondary evidence disclosed on demand.
Conventional, accessible admin controls with 44px targets, strong focus, and non-color status cues.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use archival green for primary decisions and active structure; reserve oxide for destructive or failure states rather than decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Pairing Rule
rules.body: Every status combines a recognizable icon, explicit text, and semantic color; color alone is never the message.

rules.name: The Register Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Public Sans and restrained weight changes for hierarchy; reserve monospace for literal operational identifiers, event names, and editable prompt content.

rules.name: The One Document Rule
rules.body: Give the current document and its next safe action the dominant column; never let operational summaries compete with the review workspace.

rules.name: The Disclosure Rule
rules.body: Keep routine review content open, but place technical evidence, advanced filters, admin recovery, and danger controls behind clearly labeled native disclosures.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal layering first; add shadow only to clarify a panel, sticky decision boundary, or inset shell—not to make every container float.

rules.name: The Crisp Sleeve Rule
rules.body: Prefer one bordered register surface with internal dividers over a cluster of separately rounded cards.

dos: Do preserve semantic light and dark role pairs; let inherited tokens change the theme rather than hard-coding a second component style.
Do keep primary buttons, inputs, selects, disclosure summaries, and checkbox hit areas at least 44px tall or wide.
Do use ledger rules, wrapping metadata, and progressive disclosure to simplify dense operational evidence.
Do pair every status color with its implemented icon and explicit text label.
Do keep the source document, changed metadata, and accept/reject consequences visible together when space permits.
Do slow the workflow at new correspondent, document type, or tag approvals with explicit labels and consequence copy.
donts: Don't turn the page into a generic grid of floating dashboard cards or give every container a shadow.
Don't use pure white page chrome, oversized radii, gradients, glass effects, or decorative color outside the implemented semantic roles.
Don't expose pipeline, webhook, recovery, and danger controls at the same hierarchy as routine document review.
Don't use oxide for ordinary emphasis, archival green for destructive actions, or any status color without icon and text.
Don't shrink controls below 44px, hide keyboard focus, or make unchanged facts as prominent as changed values.
Don't collapse higher-risk new entity approvals into the fast bulk-review treatment.
